messages:
Alyssa: PSA: if you set a 11:59pm waiver lock, do not then play Ranked Trivia at midnight. I missed two pickups. :sob:
Ben: same energy. I was live-typing trade offers and then the app timed out. brutal.
Marco: who did you miss? maybe I can drop someone for you tomorrow.
Alyssa: missed a 3-day streamer who ended up with 20 pts. RIP my week.
Zara: @league-commish can we agree on a sensible cutoff? midnight is chaos.
Ben: proposal: move roster lock to 10pm, waiver processing 11pm, or let FAAB bids run til 6am. trade-offs?
waiver-bot: "waiver-bot: Current settings: roster lock 11:59pm, FAAB processed at 12:05am. Pending commish vote."
Marco: Also - tiny poll: who you bench for the rest day? React: 🟢 Start the rookie / 🟡 Ride the vet / 🔴 Stream it / 🔵 Auto-bench
Alyssa: 🟢 Rookie if studs are healthy. Risk = reward.
Zara: 🔵 Auto-bench for me. My nerves cannot handle late scratches.
Ben: GIF: shifty eyes at midnight (link)
Marco: waiver-bot: "waiver-bot: Marco claimed Lane for 4 FAAB at 11:58pm. Remaining FAAB: Marco 3.2"
Alyssa: Oof that timing. Congrats Marco, also cursed timing.
Ben: End thread: can we vote on the lock times in #league-ops? I'll compile results and ping commish. Night folks, may your waiver bids be precise.
